## Checklist

- [ ] All UI text, messages, code comments and docs are in English
- [ ] No passwords, API keys, tokens or other secrets are included
- [ ] Test files and screenshots contain no real people, companies, addresses or personal data
- [ ] `README.md` / `FEATURES.md` are updated if features or limitations changed
- [ ] `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` is regenerated with `npm run notices` if dependencies changed
- [ ] New dependencies use a permissive license (no AGPL)
